hero.title: Faro Marina
hero.subtitle: The waterfront gateway of Faro, in the heart of the Algarve.

about.title: About Faro Marina
paragraphs: Faro Marina is the waterfront area located in the historic center of Faro, Algarve.
It sits next to Praça Dom Francisco Gomes, connecting the old town with the Ria Formosa lagoon.
It is a starting point for boat trips and a peaceful place for seaside walks.

thingsTodo.title: Things To Do
thingsTodo.intro: Recommended experiences around the marina and the waterfront.

items.title: Seaside Walk
items.description: Stroll along the waterfront and enjoy views of the Ria Formosa.

items.title: Watch the Sunset
items.description: The sunset over the water creates excellent light for photography.

items.title: Explore Ria Formosa
items.description: Join boat trips through the lagoon and observe local wildlife.

items.title: Old Town Walking Route
items.description: Follow the walking route from the marina into Faro's old town.

transport.title: How To Get There
transport.intro: Faro Marina is in the city center, a short walk from the train station and the bus terminal.

byAir.title: By Plane
byAir.body: Faro Airport (FAO) is about 10 km away. You can get there by taxi, bus or rental car.

byTrain.title: By Train
byTrain.body: Faro Train Station is a short walk from the marina.

byCar.title: By Car
byCar.body: Parking is available nearby. Use the button to open the route in Google Maps.

nearby.title: Nearby Attractions
nearby.intro: Points of interest within walking distance of the marina.

food.title: Food Culture
food.intro: The Algarve has a rich seafood cuisine. Here are some typical local dishes.

dishes.name: Cataplana
dishes.desc: A seafood and meat stew cooked in a traditional copper pot.

dishes.name: Grilled Sardines
dishes.desc: Grilled sardines, a summer classic of the Algarve.

dishes.name: Octopus (Polvo)
dishes.desc: Octopus baked with olive oil and potatoes.

bestTime.title: Best Time to Visit
bestTime.intro: Faro has a Mediterranean climate with over 300 sunny days a year.

seasons.note: Warm and calm, ideal for walks.
Mild and quiet, good for the city.

gallery.title: Photo Gallery
gallery.caption: Views of the marina, Ria Formosa and the sunset.

items.a: It is at Praça Dom Francisco Gomes, in the center of Faro, Algarve.
The waterfront is public and free to access; boat trips are paid.

items.q: What is the best time to visit?
items.a: Spring and autumn offer pleasant temperatures.

items.q: How to get from the airport?
items.a: You can take a taxi, bus or rental car from Faro Airport (FAO), about 10 km away.
